## Type of Change

## Checklist

Please verify before requesting a review:

- [ ] My change complies with the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tested on Raspberry Pi hardware OR verified locally using `demo/demo.py`.
- [ ] No secrets, private credentials, tokens, or personal network IP addresses are included.
- [ ] The app remains ultra-lightweight and writes straight to the framebuffer without introducing desktop/X11/Wayland dependencies.
- [ ] Any changes to environment variables or layout are reflected in `README.md` and `CONTEXT.md`.
